The plate looks like a compostable paper plate about 20 cm across, so I treated it as a side plate. It holds about 11 grapes, mostly red with a couple of green ones. Each grape is roughly 2.5–3 cm long, which puts it at about 6–7 g. Eleven grapes at that weight come to about 75 g.
